aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.title: Selected S3 source text and archive members have no detected secrets
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.description: Inspect exact selected current S3 object or existing version and supported regular text archive members with both offline detectors.
remediation: Remove exposed literals from the selected object.
Rotate confirmed exposed credentials and use scoped identities or appropriate secret references.
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.purpose: Selected source text only; no deployment association, whole-bucket coverage, reference resolution, execution or credential verification.
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.pass_observation: Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in the selected source text. Coverage is limited to the selected object or version.
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.fail_observation: A likely secret was detected in selected source text. Its value is hidden and was not validated.
aws.review.s3.selected_source_secret_ind.missing_observation: Selected content was unreadable, unsupported, incomplete or unbound. A clean result cannot be established.
